title: Shuffle Players
description: Shuffles players' positions under specific condition.
body:
Shuffles Players under specific condition.

# Usage

- To open the datapack menu, press the quick action key (default: G) or run `function shuffleplayer:menu`
- To exclude certain players from being shuffled, add the tag  "shuffleplayer.ignore" with :`tag <target> add shuffleplayer.ignore`
- To change the trigger, open the menu and change the trigger setting
#### Available triggers:
- Timer (Default)
- Jump
- Take Damage


# Features
- The time interval can be freely adjusted through the settings dialog
- A shuffle timer displayed as a bossbar
- An indicator showing who you will be teleported to
- A settings dialog accesible with the quick action key (default: G) (or with `/function shuffleplayer:menu`)
- You can change the trigger

If you would like to use this data pack in a video or other content,
please post on X with **#ShuffleDP_NY** along with a link to your content,
and the creator will check it out!
